$comment: Claims ledger (charter rule 7). Every machine-checkable claim in README.md/SPEC.md appears here with the exact command that verifies it. scripts/check-claims.sh runs each `check.cmd` with bash; exit 0 = claim holds. Two tiers: PR gate runs OFFLINE=1 (deterministic only); the live tier (nightly/manual workflow) runs ONLINE_ONLY=1 and never blocks merges. `online: true` claims hit live testnet and are skipped in the PR gate — as SKIP, never PASS.

claims.claim: the devcontainer provisions Node 24 (with docker-in-docker, Postgres client and gitleaks)
tsc --noEmit passes under the strict flag set
unit tests pass offline (no database, no network)
forward-only migrations apply from an empty database, are idempotent, and round-trip through Postgres — local Postgres only, no testnet (requires DATABASE_URL)
production code in src/ never references fixtures (charter rule 1)
LICENSE is the MIT license, copyright 2026 Stellar-Governance-Guardians

check.cmd: head -1 LICENSE | grep -q 'MIT License' && grep -q 'Copyright (c) 2026 Stellar-Governance-Guardians' LICENSE

claims.claim: gitleaks 8.30.1 is pinned in the devcontainer bootstrap and the CI gate
the PR-gate workflow (.github/workflows/ci.yml) never contacts the testnet (no RPC endpoint appears in it)
CI defines the two required checks documented in CONTRIBUTING.md: 'charter rules' and 'typecheck / lint / unit / integration / build'

check.cmd: grep -q 'name: charter rules' .github/workflows/ci.yml && grep -q 'name: typecheck / lint / unit / integration / build' .github/workflows/ci.yml
